verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos into Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot stacks; you win if you convert the level 3-8 aggression window before Teemo's poke scales.

brief.thesis: Jayce's early aggression (lane advantage and solo-kill edge both favor Jayce per measured data) comes from forcing fights on his terms with the stance-swap combo, but Teemo's zero-cooldown Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart punish any trade that drags on, which is why the matchup still only nets a 47.7% win rate over 1,759 games instead of a clean favor.

theirWindow.what: Do not walk forward to poke or auto-trade — a landed blind cancels your next attack and lets Teemo free-hit you with Toxic Shot while you can't see him.

yourWindow.when: Dart just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your engage window. Fire Shock Blast through an Acceleration Gate for extended range, or swap to Hammer Stance and leap in with To the Skies! — he has no hard CC to stop the follow-up combo.

start.why: Taken in 83.3% of games for a reason — the extra early trade damage and sustain let you contest Teemo's poke instead of being bullied off the lane before level 3.

boots.why: Cuts the downtime on your stance swap and Q/E combo loop, so you spend less time standing still waiting on cooldowns inside Blinding Dart range.

core.why: Scales your mana pool for repeated combo casts across the long poke war this lane turns into.
The active gives you the burst of speed to close a gap after he lands a poke, rather than letting him walk away on Move Quick.
Converts your mana stack into the raw damage you need to win the all-in once you've closed the distance.
Adds the burst damage to actually kill him in the short window before he can blind and disengage.

situational.when: he is landing Blinding Dart on your engage every time — the spellshield eats the blind and lets your combo land clean
Move Quick kiting is letting him walk out of your Shock Blast and leap range
you are consistently landing full combos and just need the execute threshold to close kills faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Your combo already forces movement (leap, gate dash, stance swap) — the speed burst from triggering it lets you land the poke-and-leave trade or finish an engage before Toxic Shot's damage-over-time outpaces you.

summoners.why: Taken in 56.2% of games — Ignite secures the all-in once Mercury Cannon/Hammer comes online at 6, since Teemo's Move Quick is otherwise enough to run down your damage and survive.

playing.title: Track Blinding Dart before poking
playing.detail: Never walk in to trade autos or empowered Hyper Charge hits while his Q (8s cooldown) is up — a landed blind cancels the attack and gives him a free Toxic Shot.

playing.title: Poke through the Acceleration Gate
playing.detail: Base Shock Blast range (600) is shorter than his Blinding Dart (680); firing the Q through your own Cannon Stance E gate extends its range and speed to actually outreach him.

playing.title: All-in hard at level 6
playing.detail: Combo Thundering Blow's knockback with the Mercury Cannon/Hammer transform to force a fight — he has no hard CC to punish the engage besides the blind.

playing.title: Cut melee trades short
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has no cooldown and stacks damage over time on every hit he lands — don't chain autoattacks in Hammer Stance, use Lightning Field's burst and leave.

playing.title: Don't facecheck bushes
playing.detail: His passive goes invisible after standing still briefly — ward or sweep before walking into unseen brush where he can poke for free.

playing.title: Deny his scaling once lane is even
playing.detail: If the trade war stalls past level 9-10, push waves and force objectives before Noxious Trap zoning and Toxic Shot stacking let him out-scale you.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability readings and tactical reasoning (timing windows, trade patterns, combo sequencing) are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Hexdrinker if you brought Ignite to lane. Keep some distance during early game and poke from afar.
